messages.content: Could you log me out? My username is JohnDoe and the password is JD@2023.

function.name: user_authentication_login

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to your current session information, so I can’t perform a logout action directly from here. If you’re using a web app or service, please look for a “Log Out” button or link within its interface—usually found near your profile name or settings menu. That will safely end your session.
message.reasoning:
The user wants to "log me out". They provide username/password. But we have no session context; they want logout. We can call auth API with login? Actually logging out would require invalidating session or token. There's no tool for logout. So respond politely explaining cannot do it due to lack of session.

We should not reveal sensitive info. Just say can't help.
